resources.string: Time-based mappings. No button is remapped by default.
Development build: Plus, Power and OEM gesture replacement need firmware verification. No automatic system hooks.
Choose a button, schedule and action. Save a draft while the backend is unavailable.
Rule preview only; execution depends on permissions and backend. Refresh to update the current time.
Overnight window; selected weekdays are start days.
Overlapping rules have equal priority. Change their time or priority before enabling/saving.
Changing mode disables remapping. Shizuku never silently falls back to root.
Basic observes Volume keys only. Replacement is gated to preserve unassigned long/double gestures.
Real Shizuku binder/permission detection. No verified button capture/replacement adapter yet.
API 101 and firmware hook points are unverified. This build loads no hooks or daemons.
Camera for flashlight; microphone for recording; notifications for a visible Stop action. Each permission is optional.
Observe volume keys for diagnostics. No screen content access. This development build does not replace system gestures.
These buttons perform real actions when tapped. Recording starts only while this app is visible.
Stock auto-capture needs verified readiness, shutter and saved-photo acknowledgement. This action cannot be enabled yet.
No unambiguous system camera handler found.
Root does not grant the target UID/signature. Discovered activities are shown; privileged launch is unverified.
The caller does not become the target app. Internal/protected activities cannot be selected as working mappings.
Available through Android APIs; runtime on this device is untested.
Camera permission is required for flashlight control.
Flashlight unavailable or camera is in use.
App launch requested; target screen is not confirmed.
App removed, disabled, or has no launcher activity.
Unlock to open the app. The lock screen is preserved.
Action failed. Check permissions and application state.
Microphone is active. Tap Stop to save.
Start recording from the visible app. Locked/screen-off start is unverified. Stop remains available after the schedule ends.
Recording failed; the file may not be saved. Check permissions, microphone and storage.
Up to 50 recent recordings in Music/OPlusKeyControl. No uploads.
Used by the gesture engine. These controls do not activate unverified backends.
Contains rules and selected app/activity identifiers, no audio. Restore always disables remapping.
Restore requested with remapping disabled. Review the mapping list.
Unable to read/write a valid configuration.
Configuration error. Remapping defaults off; review data before enabling.
Read-only device information. A root probe runs only when Root is selected and you tap the button.
No serial, screen content, installed-app lists or personal logs are stored. Vector runtime API is unverified.
Power single/long remain with the system. Power chords and both-volume chords are reserved.
This chord is reserved or invalid.
Includes start, excludes end. Overnight uses the start weekday. The current time zone is evaluated on each press.
Choose at least one day; start and end must differ.
The default is selected only when no scheduled rule matches.
Not ready to enable. Save a disabled mapping to complete later.
Unable to scan/open this item. Refresh or check the app.
Current profile only; cross-user/profile access is not assumed.
Run now: %1$s. This affects the device or opens the selected app.
